ideas.title: Investigating Government Anti-Fraud Efforts
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effectiveness of government anti-fraud efforts, including the creation of anti-fraud task forces and investigations into potential fraud in various programs.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the outcomes of anti-fraud efforts
questions: What are the most effective strategies for preventing and detecting fraud in government programs?
How can government agencies improve their anti-fraud efforts?
ideas.insight: This story could provide valuable insights into the effectiveness of government anti-fraud efforts and identify areas for improvement.
